##### Project general facts

Carmona offers an exclusive, harmonious community living experience inspired by Mediterranean Spanish architecture and elevated by the comfort of modern living. This exceptional development boasts stylish and spacious townhouses ranging from two and three-bedroom configurations, each thoughtfully designed to welcome indoor-outdoor living with open floor plans and elegant finishings. Every home has been carefully crafted to provide residents with a perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality.

Residents benefit from a wide range of facilities just within a short walking distance, including multiple interconnected parks, a community Clubhouse with easy access to pools, sports, and recreational facilities. The Town Center offers an array of exquisite restaurants and cafés, as well as a variety of retail options and services at the heart of the community. A large lake features designated trails for walking, running, and cycling, while amphitheaters, Sunset and Sunrise Plazas, places of worship, and outstanding international schools complete this fully integrated community.

Each residence features modern finishing with high-quality materials, creating living spaces that exude sophistication and contemporary elegance. The thoughtfully designed kitchens are equipped to ensure effortless culinary experiences, while open floor plans maximize space and natural light. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a harmonious and inviting home environment that residents will love.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Madinat Zayed, a dynamic and well-established neighborhood in the heart of Abu Dhabi known for its blend of urban convenience and cultural vibrancy. The area offers a mix of high-rise apartment buildings, office spaces, and bustling retail centers, creating a truly integrated urban environment. Strategically located in the downtown area, the neighborhood provides easy access to major landmarks and government institutions.

The area is home to a diverse community with a range of dining options, supermarkets, mosques, and essential services that cater to residents and visitors alike. Shopping destinations including shopping centers and commercial hubs are conveniently located within the neighborhood. The area's well-established infrastructure ensures that everything needed for daily life is close at hand.

The community's central location offers excellent connectivity to key destinations throughout Abu Dhabi. The neighborhood's vibrant character and comprehensive amenities create a dynamic environment where residents can enjoy both convenience and cultural richness. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of urban accessibility, community charm, and lifestyle convenience, offering an unmatched living experience in one of Abu Dhabi's most established neighborhoods.
